^OrdnanceClose-rangeEvolving greedAs you might have guessed, we will approach Server Meshing in much the same way that we are rolling out Persistent Entity Streaming\. Star Citizen Alpha 4\.0 will be a truly new era in Star Citizen\. It will mean our final tech building block – Server Meshing – will have been delivered\. The first implementation will be what we call Static Server Meshing \(SSM\), where each server is given a defined area to simulate, but as soon as SSM is stable we will move towards Dynamic Server Meshing with subsequent releases which will allow much more scalability as servers will not be bound by location, but instead will be distributed by load, allowing for much better simulation performance in any given area of the universe\.$
